description: This file defines the main Explore page component for a React-based frontend application. It manages post filtering, infinite scrolling, and fetching data from an API endpoint. It also integrates hooks for debouncing input and handling scroll events.

methods.name: fetchPage
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches a page of posts from the API based on the query parameters.

methods.name: ExplorePage
methods.description: Main React component rendering the explore page with filtering and infinite scroll.
